summary: Pre-trial difficulty design is genuine coupled catalog-plane reasoning, not clerical Go-file volume or obscure trivia. Snapshot visibility, commit-time constraints on writer snapshot plus write-set, WAL-decoded CDC, LSN/epoch-fenced FK-safe apply, checkpoint redo without epoch bump, and CLI parse-before-mutate interact so local patches stay globally wrong. Official GPT×5+Claude×5 tier is UNMEASURED / NOT_MEASURABLE.

evidence.observation: Work request states interacting end-state invariants (snapshot isolation, commit-after-WAL heap/index install, CDC-from-WAL, LSN/epoch-fenced FK-safe apply, checkpoint redo of committed records, fail-closed rejects, inspect/empty-check non-mutation, CLI exit 2 before mutation) without naming defective modules or a repair recipe.

Binding contract sequences visibility (xmin committed-or-self, xmin<=S, xmax null/uncommitted/later), COMMIT-before-install, constraint codes against snapshot plus write-set, index rebuild from committed-visible rows with tenant_id NUL code keys, decode of committed WAL only, whole-batch epoch reject vs LSN skip, recover redo of committed lsn>checkpoint without replica epoch bump.

Shift notes mix crash-pending uncommitted sku, heap-dump CDC inventing LSNs, frozen-tenant fail-closed, replica lag through sku only, keep epoch 3 / do not rewind confirmed_lsn, and --reset-output must not truncate WAL—symptoms that must be reconciled together.
Captured run shows trailing open WAL txn, heap still showing s-crash-pending, decode/apply disagreeing with replica confirmed_lsn, inspect touching replica epoch, and inspect healthy=false.

Starter Visible ignores snapshot/writer and returns LatestXmaxNull, so uncommitted crash rows and pre-images remain visible; fixing this alone does not restore replica-lag constraints, indexes, or CDC.

Starter Check scans replica sku rows, skips frozen/hold aggregate, and never overlays the writer write-set; parent-then-child same txn, FROZEN_TENANT, HOLD_QTY, and unique-on-visible still fail after a snapshot-only patch.

Starter Rebuild indexes every version with slash-separated keys and Expected always returns empty maps, so index_ok and the contracted tenant_id NUL code key remain wrong even if visibility is later repaired.
Starter Decode heap-scans sku rows, invents row-number LSNs and epoch 1, and never walks WAL COMMIT records—so applying that stream either duplicates LSNs or advances confirmed_lsn onto junk.
Starter Apply ignores fence.BatchEpochOK / Classify, orders with reverseFK true, and always writes max LSN; epoch mismatch still mutates replica and can move confirmed_lsn.
Starter Recover installs every post-checkpoint mutation including uncommitted s-crash-pending and increments replica_slot.epoch, so a recover-only heal breaks later epoch-fenced apply.
Inspect and empty-check call recover as a side effect, so a health rewrite still bumps epoch and installs uncommitted WAL—the classic false-heal of using inspect to repair crash state.
CLI appends WAL BEGIN before argv parse and --reset-output truncates WAL; unknown flags and missing --input still mutate durable state even if downstream engines are later contract-correct.
SnapshotVisible already implements the three-clause contract; the starter simply does not call it. Surrounding helper LOC is not the scored hardness.

overlay.Evaluate already merges writer mutations for PK/unique/FK/frozen/hold-qty; constraints.go ignores it and uses replica lag instead, creating a wiring trap rather than a missing-library problem.
Classify, BatchEpochOK, AdvanceConfirmed, and RejectWholeBatch already encode epoch/LSN fencing; replica.Apply discards their results.
Commit already appends WAL then heap/index install and ABORT+reject on constraint failure; hardness is the eight drifted callees, not rewriting the WAL protocol.
Oracle replaces eight interacting modules (snapshot, constraints, indexes, cdc, replica, recover, inspect, cli) then drives public catalogctl recover/decode/inspect—not a golden-output dump.

Independent F2P/P2P families cover CLI fail-closed WAL, reset-output, inspect/empty-check sentinels, unique/FK/frozen/hold-qty, same-txn parent-child, recover skip uncommitted without epoch bump, WAL-LSN CDC without crash pk, apply skip/monotonic/stale-epoch/FK order, index NUL keys, health schema, and warehouse digest. Presence checks are ancillary, not the scored hardness.

findings.why_it_matters: Packet state is PRE_LLMAJ and Harbor LLMaJ plus official 10 trials are deferred; no complete-run pass rate or per-test solvability exists, so DIFFICULTY_VERDICT cannot be a final Edition 3 tier.
findings.minimal_remediation: After Pre-LLMaJ/Harbor maturity, run GPT-5.5 ×5 and Claude Opus 4.8 ×5 and set DIFFICULTY_VERDICT from the combined complete-run mean; do not invent trial stats now.
findings.regression_risk: None for design PASS; empirical tier may differ from this design judgment.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction plus contract enumerate the end-state rules, starter comments name each drifted function, and helpers already implement SnapshotVisible, overlay.Evaluate, fence.Classify, and applyorder.Order. A strong agent may spec-wire the eight modules without deep diagnosis. That raises shortcut risk but does not make the work clerical: recover-without-epoch, WAL-decode-without-uncommitted, snapshot-without-write-set overlay, NUL index keys, CLI parse-before-BEGIN, and inspect-without-recover still interact, and sentinels/stale-epoch/parent-child reject partial heals.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep coupled counterexamples and inspect/empty-check sentinels. Do not further flatten the instruction into a per-file repair list. Recalibrate shortcut risk from official trajectories if pass rate is unexpectedly high.
findings.regression_risk: Low if hidden sentinels, stale-epoch, and same-txn parent-child families remain independent.

findings.why_it_matters: The agent tree contains many already-correct helpers (engine commit/decode/apply wiring, WAL protocol, heap install, visibility, overlay, fence, applyorder, health). Difficulty is not Go LOC or package count. A solver who hunts every module may waste time, but the minimum successful chain is diagnosis of the eight coupled defects plus contract-faithful snapshot/CDC/apply/recover/CLI behavior.
findings.minimal_remediation: Do not add extra unrelated packages to inflate perceived difficulty. Do not treat warehouse dump size or surrounding catalog helpers as a reasoning bottleneck.

missing_evidence: Combined 10-trial per-test solvability matrix and trajectories
do_not_change: Do not collapse snapshot visibility, write-set constraints, WAL CDC, epoch/LSN apply fencing, recover-without-epoch, inspect non-mutation, and CLI fail-closed parse into a single-module bug to chase early pass rate.
Do not treat surrounding helper/warehouse Go LOC as the difficulty signal.
Do not assign a final Edition 3 tier before combined official 10 trials.
next_gate: Continue Pre-LLMaJ / Harbor path; defer official model trials for empirical tier

REASONING_CHAIN_ESTIMATE: Diagnose crash-pending heap row, heap-dump CDC, replica lag through sku, inspect epoch bump, and WAL-truncating --reset-output from oncall, bounce log, contract, and public catalogctl runs
Restore snapshot visibility as committed xmin (or read-your-writes), xmin<=S, and xmax null/uncommitted/later so uncommitted versions never appear as catalog inventory

Evaluate COMMIT constraints on writer snapshot plus write-set (not replica lag): UNIQUE/FK/CHECK/FROZEN_TENANT/HOLD_QTY fail closed with reject+WAL ABORT and no heap/index install; same-txn parent sku then child offer must commit
Rebuild sku_code/offer_code from currently visible committed rows with tenant_id NUL code keys after successful COMMIT and recover; aborted and invisible versions must not remain
Decode CDC from WAL committed mutations in lsn order from confirmed_lsn+1, skipping abort/open txns and never inventing heap row-number LSNs; do not apply or advance the slot in decode

Apply CDC with whole-batch epoch reject (nothing applied, confirmed_lsn unchanged), skip lsn<=confirmed, FK-rank order within txn, and monotonic confirmed_lsn; recover redos only committed lsn>checkpoint without bumping replica epoch

Parse/validate CLI before any WAL/heap/index/replica/slot mutation; unknown flags or omitted commit --input exit 2; --reset-output clears out/ only; inspect and empty-check rewrite health.json without recover, decode-apply, epoch bump, or WAL append
role_output.PER_TEST_COVERAGE: Oracle/NOP only; official 10-trial solvability not yet measured
